verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a local, open-source transcoding CLI and library. It stores no user account data, so there is nothing to export before leaving, and the data-portability axis is a category error for this kind of tool. Its ability to convert media files into many formats is a different capability (file conversion), not an export-your-data feature, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
